rationale: Generic chart-shader work. The Skia chart composer derives its along/across chart for ring, flat and rounded segments and stadium as well as the flat arc, adds cross and halfWidth to PulpChart, cuts the flat arc's d at its flat caps, and scales the premultiplied colour (not alpha alone) by the chart feather. Pulp-owned named chart-shader presets (bevel, inset channel, tube, light pipe, centre highlight, glow) are plain SkSL fed to that existing API, reachable from JS, and the widget gallery gains a row of knobs showing each one, which adds them to the gallery's render corpus; a knob with a chart shader and no body shader now paints the chart. Pulp continues to own these targets under the 2026-10-04 design-import refactor inheritance decision; Vellum inherits the canvas changes when the targets adopt the Vellum package. No design-import, Chromium, rendering or packaging authority moves.
tests: ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart feather keeps the colour premultiplied'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: ring and flat arc chart t around and cross radially'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'SDF chart: segments and stadium chart t along and cross across'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'WidgetBridge installs named chart shader presets on a knob'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'lit chart presets follow the light direction'
ctest --test-dir build -R 'widget gallery shows every chart shader preset on a knob'
